decisions.reason: Its quantified cost-saving result and alignment with the established offer make withdrawal unlikely, and sunk costs plus public commitment reinforce persistence.
A dedicated website page signals public commitment and it is close to the established offer, so management will likely persist to justify the investment.
As a flagship product line central to the announced direction, high visibility and sunk costs strongly incline the firm to maintain it despite any early disappointments.

Although only mentioned on the website and less visibly committed, it is close to established business and early results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so escalation leads to keeping it.
